041858: // The FLOAT_TO_FLOAT arm.  An imaginary literal is left to the evaluator,
041859: // which refuses it rather than folding its magnitude.
041860: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_float_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end, u8* bytes)
041861: {
041862:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
041863:     bool negative = end - start == 2 && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
041864:     String8 spelling = c_token_spelling(builder->preprocess.spelling_base, tokens[end - 1]);
041865:     String8 ignored_real_spelling = {0};
041866:     f64 floating = 0.0;
041867:     char8 suffix = 0;
041868:     c_ir_float_suffix(spelling, &suffix);
041869:     bool wide_source = (suffix == 'l' || suffix == 'L') && target_data_layout(builder->target).long_double_type.bit_width > 64;
041870:     bool folded = !c_ir_number_imaginary_spelling(builder->arena, spelling, &ignored_real_spelling);
041871:     if (folded && wide_source)
041872:     {
041873:         CIrConstantValue source = {0};
041874:         CIrConstantValue converted = {0};
041875:         folded = c_ir_constant_float_literal(builder, spelling, &source) && c_ir_constant_cast(builder, &source, child->id, &converted);
041876:         floating = converted.floating;
041877:     }
041878:     else if (folded)
041879:     {
041880:         folded = c_ir_float_literal_value(spelling, &floating, &suffix);
041881:     }
041882:     if (folded)
041883:     {
041884:         c_ir_constant_initializer_store_float_leaf(child, negative ? -floating : floating, bytes);
041885:     }
041886:     return folded;
041887: }

041889: // The CHARACTER_TO_INTEGER arm: the constant's type is the one the evaluator
041890: // gives it, int unless the prefix says otherwise.
041891: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_character_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end, u8* bytes)
041892: {
041893:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
041894:     bool signed_prefix = end - start == 2;
041895:     bool negative = signed_prefix && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
041896:     u64 character = 0;
041897:     CTypeKind kind = C_TYPE_INVALID;
041898:     bool folded = c_ir_decode_character_value(builder->arena, builder->preprocess.spelling_base, tokens[end - 1], builder->target, &character, &kind);
041899:     IrType* literal_type = 0;
041900:     if (folded)
041901:     {
041902:         IrTypeId type = builder->scalar_types[kind];
041903:         literal_type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, type.value == IR_ID_UNDERLYING_INVALID ? builder->s32_type : type);
041904:         folded = literal_type != 0;
041905:     }
041906:     if (folded && signed_prefix)
041907:     {
041908:         folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(builder, &literal_type, &character, negative);
041909:     }
041910:     if (folded)
041911:     {
041912:         c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(child, literal_type, character, bytes);
041913:     }
041914:     return folded;
041915: }

041917: // The IDENTIFIER_TO_INTEGER arm: an enumerator, a constexpr object or C23's
041918: // `true`/`false`, resolved by c_ir_constant_identifier exactly as the
041919: // evaluator resolves a lone identifier.  A name that resolves to anything
041920: // but an integer constant -- an object, a function, `nullptr`, an unknown --
041921: // is declined to the general folder, which refuses or folds it as before.
041922: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_fold_identifier_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrType* child, u32 start, u32 end, u8* bytes)
041923: {
041924:     CToken* tokens = builder->preprocess.tokens;
041925:     bool signed_prefix = end - start == 2;
041926:     bool negative = signed_prefix && c_token_is_punctuator(&tokens[start], C_PUNCTUATOR_MINUS);
041927:     CIrConstantValue value = {0};
041928:     bool folded = c_ir_constant_identifier(builder, end - 1, &value) && value.kind == C_IR_CONSTANT_INTEGER;
041929:     IrType* constant_type = folded ? ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, value.type) : 0;
041930:     u64 integer = value.integer;
041931:     folded = constant_type != 0;
041932:     if (folded && signed_prefix)
041933:     {
041934:         folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_leaf_unary(builder, &constant_type, &integer, negative);
041935:     }
041936:     if (folded)
041937:     {
041938:         c_ir_constant_initializer_store_integer_leaf(child, constant_type, integer, bytes);
041939:     }
041940:     return folded;
041941: }

041943: #if !BUSTER_OPTIMIZE
041944: // The differential gate: a leaf an arm folded is folded again through the
041945: // general folder into scratch, and the two answers must be the same bytes.
041946: // Debug builds only -- the general fold is the cost the arms exist to
041947: // remove, and the Release tree carries the tests.
041948: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL void c_ir_constant_initializer_check_literal_leaf(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, IrTypeId child_type, IrType* child, u32 start,
041949:                                                                      u32 end, u8* bytes, u64 child_offset)
041950: {
041951:     u8 scratch[16] = {0};
041952:     u32 scratch_relocation_count = 0;
041953:     BUSTER_CHECK(child->layout.size <= sizeof(scratch));
041954:     bool legacy_folded = c_ir_constant_initializer_bytes_legacy(builder, start, end, child_type, scratch, child->layout.size, child_offset, 0,
041955:                                                                 &scratch_relocation_count, 0);
041956:     BUSTER_CHECK(legacy_folded && memory_compare(scratch, bytes, child->layout.size));
041957: }
041958: #endif

041960: BUSTER_C_INTERNAL bool c_ir_constant_initializer_context_step(CIntegerIrBuilder* builder, CIrConstantInitializerContext* context)
041961: {
041962:     CIrConstantInitializerFrame* frames = context->frames;
041963:     CIrConstantInitializerContinuation* continuation_work = context->continuation_work;

041969:     u32 relocation_capacity = context->relocation_capacity;
041970:     u32 capacity = context->frame_capacity;
041971:     u32 frame_count = context->frame_count;
041972:     u64 span = context->span;
041973:     while (frame_count)
041974:     {
041975:         CIrConstantInitializerFrame* frame = frames + frame_count - 1;
041976:         if (!c_initializer_consume_separator(builder->preprocess.tokens, frame->limit, &frame->cursor, frame->next_index))
041977:         {
041978:             return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid initializer separator"), frame->cursor);
041979:         }
041980:         bool designated = frame->cursor < frame->limit && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||
041981:                                                            c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_DOT));
041982:         if (designated && frame->borrowed)
041983:         {
041984:             u32 designated_cursor = frame->cursor;
041985:             while (frame_count && frames[frame_count - 1].borrowed)
041986:             {
041987:                 frame_count -= 1;
041988:                 if (frame_count)
041989:                 {
041990:                     frames[frame_count - 1].cursor = designated_cursor;
041991:                 }
041992:             }
041993:             if (!frame_count)
041994:             {
041995:                 return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid aggregate designator"), frame->cursor);
041996:             }
041997:             frame = frames + frame_count - 1;
041998:             if (!c_initializer_consume_separator(builder->preprocess.tokens, frame->limit, &frame->cursor, frame->next_index))
041999:             {
042000:                 return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("invalid initializer separator"), frame->cursor);
042001:             }
042002:             designated = frame->cursor < frame->limit && (c_token_is_punctuator(&builder->preprocess.tokens[frame->cursor], C_PUNCTUATOR_LEFT_BRACKET) ||

042004:         }
042005:         IrType* type = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, frame->type);
042006:         u64 slot_count = type ? c_ir_constant_initializer_slot_count(builder, type) : 0;
042007:         if (!type || !type->layout.resolved || frame->cursor >= frame->limit || (frame->next_index >= slot_count && !designated))
042008:         {
042009:             if (!type || (!frame->borrowed && frame->cursor < frame->limit && frame->next_index >= slot_count))
042010:             {
042011:                 return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("initializer has more elements than the aggregate can hold"), frame->cursor);
042012:             }
042013:             u32 cursor = frame->cursor;
042014:             bool borrowed = frame->borrowed;
042015:             frame_count -= 1;
042016:             if (borrowed && frame_count) frames[frame_count - 1].cursor = cursor;
042017:             continue;

042019:         CIrConstantInitializerDesignator designator = {0};
042020:         if (!c_ir_constant_initializer_designator(builder, frame, continuation_work, (u32)(span + 1), range_work, (u32)(span + 1), &designator)) return false;

042022:         u32 value_start = designator.value_start;
042023:         if ((!designator.has_designator && designator.selected_end >= slot_count) ||
042024:             (type && (type->kind == IR_TYPE_ARRAY || type->kind == IR_TYPE_VECTOR) && designator.selected_end >= slot_count))
042025:         {
042026:             return c_ir_constant_initializer_fail(builder, S8("array designator index is outside the array bounds"), frame->cursor);
042027:         }
042028:         IrTypeId child_type = designator.value_type;
042029:         IrType* child = ir_type_from_id(&builder->program->types, child_type);
042030:         u64 child_offset = designator.value_offset;
042031:         if (!child) return false;

042033:         if (value_end <= value_start)

042036:         }

042042:             context->frame_count = frame_count;
042043:             context->step = C_IR_CONSTANT_INITIALIZER_CONTEXT_PUSH_RANGE;

042046:         bool merge_union = designator.clear_union && frame->has_last_union && designator.clear_field != UINT32_MAX &&
